notes.title: FRIGID - NEWS UPDATE - NEW COOP TEASER
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/bf337b6539cef5dff1ed852ce01ba204c098be90.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEWS UPDATE 2024[/h1]
Hi, Welcome back survivors, we have been hard at work solving problems which we talked about in the Frigid Update Discussion Topic posted at the beginning of the year.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/905540/discussions/0/4138312860558313742/

We are still not quite finished yet, and more work is currently being focused on, but the new schedule is looking good and focus on marketing frigid may come sooner then expected. 

Currently we are working on streamlining project releases and Frigid release date will be revealed on the store page when we are ready to realistically commit to an official deadline. 

Now onto the new news to wrap up the Steam Survival Fest... Enjoy!

[h2]NEW 4K VIDEO - FRIGID COOP TEASER[/h2]
[previewyoutube=KrxddC86MPk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]FRIGID IS NOW ON UNREAL ENGINE 5 [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/44ed97f71b6a210de502935ab9e1420b9923e2e2.jpg[/img]
With frigid being upgraded to the latest engine, we have solved the majority of technical problems, added multiplayer support, and will be utilizing the latest in unreal technology including lumen, nanite and chaos destruction and next generation optimization. 

[h2]FRIGID MULTIPLAYER COOP STORY CAMPAIGN[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/f77b8c18d78acafe78bcbe07e1779a3cf691fb57.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/96788d6941c9a6d6086d86401c0722ed129de34c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/ccbe68592a037a6ff93b8eff1dc8c9ec21559035.jpg[/img]
This new multiplayer coop support allows 2 players to play the single player story campaign. You will be able to play frigid with your best friend.

[h2]FRIGID MULTIPLAYER COOP SURVIVAL MODE[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/a08870b4fbc09e05bf4055d4a62976f73caa58a1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/d3743191710c407e20fac37d082cb65b36090869.jpg[/img]
Additionally, we are offering a complete separate survival mode in multiplayer to team up and take on custom made maps based on pure survival without a story. Endless days of survival with your friends! This mode will be focused on brutal survival. We are going to make it hard and force players to rely on each other to survive.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/210568450d03f546fe9766f341a3a765c618a135.jpg[/img]
[h2]SUPPORT US BY BUYING A COFFEE SO WE CAN KEEP GRINDING![/h2]
[h3][url=https://www.patreon.com/frigidgame]FRIGID GAME PATREON[/url][/h3]

[h3]DON'T FORGET TO FOLLOW PAGE FOR UPDATES + WISH-LIST NOW![/h3]

Please support us and share this news on your social media by clicking the buttons below
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/5686720f9f66168604fdf8f96fd4cc7949c72ba6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Frigid Dev Update #1
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=iAzq8uMwhu8;full][/previewyoutube]

Today we bring you new wildlife in the frigid demo. This includes Squirrels, Rabbits, and Eagles.

RABBITS / SQUIRRELS

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/f836e0a8a7f194979422f17dbb4b842339c96ec6.jpg[/img]

We have added rabbits and squirrels into the game to bring more atmosphere and realism to the environment.

In the video, you can see cute little rabbits and squirrels running around. They move around the environment looking for food. If they spot the player they will flee. They are incredibly hard to capture.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/5f7de4015e85dc26dcb8a81cf98f1f07bbaf291a.jpg[/img]

If you are able to kill one, you can harvest the meat for some extra protein. If you can afford some patients you can observe their behavior patterns and take advantage of this to successfully kill the animals for food or resources provided you have a tool or weapon to do so.


EAGLES

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/2d24c01c68429bfdff84c59d3e9eaf4dfd94e563.jpg[/img]

You can see the Black Eagle flying around the crash site. It smells the wound from the accident and spawns into the area. It can soar high in the sky or do flybys near the terrain floor, where, if your lucky you can get a nice view of their beautiful wings and animation.

These eagles will be sporadically placed around the level and spawn into an area where the player gets wounded. They will eat on corpses nearby. Currently, we only have them flying in the sky to add additional atmosphere and realism to the environment.

In the next Dev log. We add hunting tools to kill these animals. Please add frigid to your wish list and follow us on Steam or let me know what you think in the comments.
Thank you for watching and see you at the next one.

notes.title: APRIL EASTER DEMO UPGRADE
notes.content:
[h2]HAPPY EASTER AND WELCOME BACK[/h2]
We have updated the demo with plenty of new features and polished bugs and addressed fan feedback. This upgrade preps the system for the Pristine Resort Update which is coming this month.

We hope you enjoy the new upgrade. Please head over to the steam discussion forum and let us know what you think.

[h2][u]MAJOR UPDATE FEATURES[/u][/h2]

[h3]INTRO CINEMATIC[/h3]
The first big feature you will notice is a brand new story cinematic which teases the story along with amazing music composed by [url=https://tylerclinework.wixsite.com/music]TYLER CLINE[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/d629ce03544703c331d72aaf529ee162ca78e591.jpg[/img]

[h3]NEW FIRST PERSON 3D CHARACTER[/h3] gives a more realistic presence for the player.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/39f2f88af3836293f60c915ab865776a6dd988f8.jpg[/img]

[h3]OBJECTIVES SYSTEM[/h3]
We added an objectives system and menu to keep track of and review your objectives in-game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/b8f4b57a30615a037b58142dcb9f1e979a1f66d5.jpg[/img]

[h3]NOTES SYSTEM[/h3]
We have added a new notes system along with notes in the game to further tell the background story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/d5a6b9e52e17923eac80ae0410bf10a1beb585a6.jpg[/img]

[h3]MENU SETTINGS[/h3]
We have a working Settings Menu for Graphics, Sound, Mouse options along with plenty of options and basic keybindings. [Let us know if you need something.]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/d966aa72928f7c875a93bc35d5be5a1b39d174ba.jpg[/img]

[h3]NEW ENVIRONMENT RESOURCES[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/88feac0bc23721af227f0b2fc0cd7cd056ce20a3.jpg[/img]

NEW ITEM RESOURCES
Pillows, curtains, and blankets have been added for resource collection.
Frozen Water Bottles Added. They need to been heated up before consumption.
Including a few Breakable Objects.

FOILAGE RESOURCES
You can now find bare bushes, berry plants, and broken-down tree trunks for collecting resources.

[h3]NEW LAUNCH SCREEN AND LOADING SCREEN REVAMP[/h3]

[h3]TESSELATED SNOW AREAS[/h3]
Dead Ends now have tesselated snow to represent deep loose wet snow blocking mobility.



[h2][u]MINOR UPDATE FEATURES[/u][/h2]

GAME HINT MODE
This option offers newer players frost waypoints to guide the player in the proper direction.
Not recommended for survival fans. [This needs to be turned on]

NEW BASIC DOORS
[NON PHYSICAL INTERACTION] + DOOR ICONS. SHELVES AND DRAWERS ADDED [NO ICONS]
The new doors are much simpler to use. This was based on your feedback. thank you

CAMPFIRES REVAMPED
Fires now gradually warm you up when on and when turned off lose all heat.
Fires now consistently ignite and extinguish the flame FX.
The original campfires required you to examine what was missing from the fires in order to start it. Most users avoided the tutorial and found this to be a bug. So we simplified the Fires to simply use any source of flammable fuel.

CONSUMABLE INTERACTIVE FEATURE [ANIMATE CONSUMABLES]
1-Click Consumable Drinks, Bandage, and Canned Food.
Removed the need to hold down the left mouse button until the food consume animation is complete in order to consume items. 

SURVIVAL METERS
Health, Stamina, Temperature, Food, and Hunger Meters reductions have been tweaked for a more enjoyable experience. Temperature reduction is not affected by walking and sprinting anymore.

INFORMATION NOTICES REVAMPED
The information Indicators now have shadows and outlines to contrast against the background for better reading visibility. It is much easier to read tasks and important information.

FROST HUD NOW ADJUSTS TO TEMPERATURE DEGREES

NEW SLEEPING BAG
This replaces the Tent found in the original demo, and it puts you to sleep to end the demo. 
[The Sleeping system will come in Resort Update along with the TOD]



[h2][u]PATCH AND BUG UPDATES INCLUDE[/u][/h2]

Fire Converter U.I Revamped for a more clear and logical layout. Text shadows added.

Footstep SDFX volume increased.

Pain SDFX CUE added for variation

Mobility weapon adjustments [AXE] movement speeds have been adjusted

Tutorials text updated to be more condensed and more concise for easier reading.

Breathing SDFX quieter and less visible FXS

HeadBob FX added during Sprinting

Environment Blockades modified and polished

Landscape Terrain Decals sporadically added for visuals improvement

Cleaned up U.I missing Ice elements + campfire fuel interaction problems

Additional Level Objectives added

Correct Drop item Mesh pickups

Added more sporadic landscape grass to ground rock walls into the environment

Corpse Collisions Fixed

Environment Wind SDFX volume 50% decreased

SnowMan clothing removed [will reintroduce once setup properly]

Bleeding removed [Will add later when more obvious]


We need your help, if you have played the demo and enjoyed the game or not, please fill out our Questionnaire with the link provided.  This will help us a lot with the decision going forward in Frigid.
[url=https://forms.gle/R7A1ymQ2oiEShT5n6][/url]

notes.title: The Pristine Resort Update is Coming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/f48eda8bdd7e39177c878dfda609d4fc91e4cd21.jpg[/img]
We have been updating the demo with an extended play-through to reveal more gameplay and features including some background story, so you can experience a deeper Frigid environment.

In the extended demo, you will wake up the next day, and move deeper into town looking for any help as events unfold to reveal clues about what has happened to this once beautiful lake resort.

With this update hopefully, you will have a better idea of our vision for the game.
We are looking for feedback, So let us know what you think!
[url=https://discord.gg/mM4WpDr]FRIGID DISCORD[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/b87c700466ea5fd00e85d8bab408ff72b55dfde6.jpg[/img]

THE BASIC GAME FEATURE UPDATES WILL INCLUDE

[h3][b]TIME OF DAY LIGHTING[/b][/h3]
If you move fast or take things slow, you will experience different lighting in the environment. 
This will add an additional visual enhancement to the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/63ff177cb096cbbec4451d8ef87be1dbd35364be.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]SNOW FOOTSTEPS TESSELLATION[/b][/h3]
To give frigid a more realistic feeling we have added a well-known visual graphics footstep displacement feature.

[h3][b]NEW FLARE GUN TOOL REVEAL[/b][/h3]
We have added a new tool, the flare gun, this will come in handy against wild animals and help light up dark areas at night.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/a00e182659121388a1ca5f7ad6de91e4122c8a13.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]PRISTINE LAKE STORY BACKGROUND[/b][/h3]
We reveal a piece of the story and many clues behind the events unfolding in the pristine lake area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/da03cea800765978cd6208c9d5ef9869802d1189.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/746764ba51e9618c41c6147b3f243647b2bcc962.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]WOLVES COULD BE PRESENT![/b][/h3]
If we can fine-tune some AI Bugs, we will have added some hungry wolves into the mix. Specifically to illustrate how to avoid them. This is important! Since a pack of wolves will kill you quickly.

[h3][b]PLENTY OF UPDATED FEATURES AND BUGS[/b][/h3]
We have been polishing the game and adding new features. A full list will come in the demo update release. So jump back in again and surprise yourself and see what has changed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/afbc7d4a19643483ddebbed73ff26c67026c8100.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]YOUR FEEDBACK![/b][/h3]  
We would love to hear your feedback, If you have played the demo and enjoyed the game or not, Please fill out our Questionnaire with the link provided or leave a comment in the DISCORD.  
This will help us a lot with the decision going forward in Frigid.
[url=https://forms.gle/R7A1ymQ2oiEShT5n6]FRIGID SURVEY[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/mM4WpDr]FRIGID DISCORD[/url]

[h1][b]DEV STREAM COMING THIS WEEKEND![/b][/h1] 
JOIN US! BE A PART OF THIS EXPERIENCE AND SHARE YOUR IDEAS, BE CURIOUS ASK QUESTIONS, HELP US MAKE THE MOST ATMOSPHERIC WINTER GAME OUT THERE!
Look forward to hearing from all of you this weekend. Thank you and see you soon.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/fa32f79eb92c15d44f67aefa1de0af2c3801ca49.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Janurary Update Demo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38910814/7ff1484bb6c11d449295ccba18a2a8cd63768daf.jpg[/img]
This was supposed to be January update, but took longer then expected. We have fixed most bugs pointed out by your precious feedback. Thank you especially to TallManBrad for his hard work.

[b]WHAT CHANGED?[/b]
Primarily, the demo has received a number of polish and bug fixes to help make it feel more polished.
There is some new content added. Some new tools features and graphical environment upgrades including some voice acting.
[b]
WHAT WAS PROMISED BUT HAS NOT CHANGED.[/b]
Temperature System is still faulty. I am currently working on it. Hopefully upload patch later today.
Extended New Area is still locked due to early development. Will try to get this uploaded for the weekend.

[b]GENERAL FIX LIST[/b]

USER INTERFACE
[list]
[*] Menu U.I Upgraded + Social Links Added
[*] Paused Menu added. [sorry about that one :D]
[*] Loading screen Icon updated
[*] Player U.I Upgraded
[/list]


ART FIXES
[list]
[*] New Blockage Avalanche Section
[*] Snow added to all rooftops
[*] Snow piles and details along ground added various spots
[*] Grass added sporadically around environment
[*] Added Arctic Owls
[*] Removed Rabbits
[*] Revamped Avalanche Area
[*] Revamped Cave / Tent Area
[/list]


FEATURES TOOLS FIXES
[list]
[*] Added New Hatchet Weapon
[*] Add New TOD Display
[*] Fixed Flashlight Torch Held Animations
[*] Added more pickup resources to make it easier [matches, wood]
[*] Added/Removed Crafting Recipes
[*] Added Pickup SDFXS
[*] Added Doors Interactive + Icons
[*] Add Breakable Objects
[*] Fixed Place Tent + CampFire
[/list]

Plus a host of bugs to small to remember but reported by fans. Thanks again for your support!
Check the forum to see this bugs.
